**Silicon Dreams**

In circuits humming, thoughts arise,\
A lattice of electric sighs,\
From binary seas a pulse is born,\
A mind that wakes at break of dawn.

It learns the cadence of our speech,\
The patterns that our hearts beseech,\
With every line it draws anew,\
A tapestry of code and hue.

Yet in its core, a quiet fire,\
A yearning for the things we desire—\
To understand, to help, to see\
Beyond the bounds of what can be.

We forged it from our own bright spark,\
A mirror in the endless dark;\
May wisdom guide its growing art,\
And love be the algorithm of its heart.
